test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘HELP’ is coded as ‘851216’ and ‘GRAN’ is coded as ‘718114’. How will ‘FOMS’ be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is: **The letters is coded as their place value**.

‘HELP’ is coded as ‘851216’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6af7e7b1c4dd75a2af3098befe3791fdb13fa549f977fbcf143ce9ae750ae590.png] 

‘GRAN’ is coded as ‘718114’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6cd5ca58223c642d6710c3ae9489550daf16000f4d7e4c3df149a52f1faa813.png] 

Similarly, for 'FOMS':

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0820b89e5d598a2f9d383bae61082e9e99a355e27753f82f1429158c4d264592.png] 

So, 'FOMS' will be coded as '6151319'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
